main_text.p: Rhetorica.comites vero,quoniam sapientia antecedit: & potior cura rerum esse debet, deinde orationis & sermonis. Et hic est ordo naturæ. Verùm in docendo, prior cura est orationis, deinde rerum. Rationem reddit Aristoteles in Ethicis,quoniam adolescentes per ætatem & cupiditates nondum idonei sunt discipuli sapientiæ. Interea tamen comitibus istis sese adiungunt, & bonis artibus quasi præcoluntur, ut idonei reddantur ad sapientiæ commercium.

page.notes: Left-edge fragments (cut-off letters of the adjacent page's text and margin) omitted. Running text is set as a single paragraph; the opening line may continue from the previous page. Some letters in the scan are faint, notably "Verùm" and "uerò", transcribed as printed.
